movies.title: The Dark Knight
movies.overview: When the menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc on Gotham, Batman must accept one of the greatest psychological and physical tests of his ability to fight injustice.

movies.title: Inception
movies.overview: A thief who steals corporate secrets through dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a CEO.

movies.title: Batman Begins
movies.overview: After training with his mentor, Batman begins his fight to free crime-ridden Gotham City from corruption.

movies.title: The Dark Knight Rises
movies.overview: Eight years after the Joker's reign, Batman is coerced out of exile to face the mysterious Bane.

movies.title: Interstellar
movies.overview: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival.

movies.title: Oppenheimer
movies.overview: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer and his role in the development of the atomic bomb.

movies.title: The Matrix
movies.overview: A computer hacker learns from mysterious rebels about the true nature of his reality and his role in the war against its controllers.

movies.title: The Matrix Reloaded
movies.overview: Neo and the rebel leaders estimate they have 72 hours until Zion falls under attack.

movies.title: Gladiator
movies.overview: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family.

movies.title: The Martian
movies.overview: An astronaut becomes stranded on Mars and must rely on his ingenuity to survive.

movies.title: Fight Club
movies.overview: An insomniac office worker and a soap maker form an underground fight club that evolves into something much more.

movies.title: Pulp Fiction
movies.overview: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, and a gangster intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.

movies.title: Kill Bill: Volume 1
movies.overview: After awakening from a four-year coma, a former assassin wreaks vengeance on the team who betrayed her.

movies.title: Black Swan
movies.overview: A committed dancer wins the lead role in Swan Lake only to find herself struggling to maintain her sanity.

movies.title: Requiem for a Dream
movies.overview: The drug-induced utopias of four people are shattered when their addictions run deep.

movies.title: Forrest Gump
movies.overview: The presidencies of Kennedy and Johnson, the Vietnam War, and other events unfold from the perspective of an Alabama man.

movies.title: 3 Idiots
movies.overview: Two friends are searching for their long lost companion. They revisit their college days and recall the memories of their friend who inspired them to think differently.

movies.title: Dangal
movies.overview: Former wrestler Mahavir Singh Phogat and his two wrestler daughters struggle towards glory at the Commonwealth Games in the face of societal oppression.

movies.title: Padmaavat
movies.overview: A legendary Rajput queen, known for her beauty and courage, becomes the obsession of a tyrannical Sultan.

movies.title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
movies.overview: A young mute girl from Pakistan gets lost in India with no way to head back. A devoted man undertakes a task to get her back to her motherland and unite her with her family.

movies.title: PK
movies.overview: An alien on Earth loses the only device he can use to communicate with his spaceship. His innocent nature and child-like questions force the country to evaluate its religious beliefs.

movies.title: Chennai Express
movies.overview: A man's journey from Mumbai to Rameshwaram changes when he meets the daughter of a local don on the train.

movies.title: Barfi!
movies.overview: A hearing-impaired man and an autistic woman find love and happiness in their unique relationship.

movies.title: Ghajini
movies.overview: A short-term memory loss patient sets out on a vengeance-filled journey to avenge his lover's death.

movies.title: Baahubali: The Beginning
movies.overview: A villager learns his royal heritage and sets out to reclaim his kingdom from a tyrannical ruler.

movies.title: Baahubali 2: The Conclusion
movies.overview: When Shiva, the son of Bahubali, learns about his heritage, he begins to look for answers to his story.

movies.title: RRR
movies.overview: A fictitious story about two legendary revolutionaries and their journey away from home before they started fighting for their country in the 1920s.

movies.title: Pushpa: The Rise
movies.overview: A coolie rises in the world of red sandalwood smuggling, making powerful enemies along the way.

movies.title: Eega
movies.overview: A murdered man is reincarnated as a housefly and seeks to avenge his death while protecting his lover.

movies.title: Enthiran
movies.overview: A brilliant scientist designs a humanoid robot, but things go wrong when the robot falls in love with his fiancée.
When mobile phones start flying away, Dr. Vaseegaran reassembles Chitti to defeat a mysterious force.

movies.title: Thuppakki
movies.overview: An army captain on leave discovers a terrorist sleeper cell in Mumbai and sets out to dismantle it.

movies.title: Ghajini
movies.overview: A man with short-term memory loss seeks revenge for his lover's murder. The original Tamil version later remade in Hindi.

movies.title: Ponniyin Selvan: I
movies.overview: Vandiyathevan sets out to cross the Chola empire to deliver a message from the crown prince Aditha Karikalan.

movies.title: Drishyam
movies.overview: A man tries to protect his family from the dark side of the law after they commit an unexpected crime.

movies.title: Lucifer
movies.overview: A political Godfather's death triggers a power struggle that tests the loyalty of his successors.

movies.title: Vikram
movies.overview: A special investigator uncovers a case involving masked serial killers, only to discover there is more to it.

movies.title: Sita Ramam
movies.overview: An orphaned soldier's life transforms after receiving a letter from a woman named Sita, leading to a timeless love story.

movies.title: Bangalore Days
movies.overview: Three young cousins dream of living in Bangalore, and their lives change when they reunite in the city.
